generation_review.prompt: Draw exactly ONE original Small Seal glyph from the first attached four-specimen reference sheet. The four slots THX CCZ QJZ DYC all depict the SAME codepoint; examine every available specimen equally. A slot UNAVAILABLE is absent evidence. Choose ONE coherent historical whole construction where variants differ, preserving every branch, bar, loop, counter, detached mark and opening. Do not blend incompatible variant components or substitute a modern Chinese character. Second image is prior finished glyph used ONLY for stroke style, never copy its different character identity. Reconstruct smooth genuine centerline trajectories with absolutely CONSTANT width black strokes, round caps and round joins, precise straight bars and smooth rounded curves; no brush taper, pressure, swelling, blobs, serifs, texture or extra components. All strokes share one width about3% full canvas. Square1:1 canvas with ONE complete centered glyph inside central70%, generous clear margins. Transparent background, pure black strokes. Output only the ONE glyph: no text, labels, frame, chart, grid, multiple specimens, watermark or shadow. Keep all white counters open and all detached components separate. Preserve the natural tall proportions and bar lengths of the chosen attested construction. U+3D08E: LEFT three-bar I-shaped component. RIGHT TWO adjacent repeated identical vertical forms, separated by clear white gap. EACH repeated form has an upward THREE-PRONG fork at top, with center stem continuing all the way down to baseline. Below top fork EACH form has one inverted-U arch whose TWO long outer legs descend to almost baseline, while the center stem descends through arch interior slightly longer. Thus exactly TWO upper forks and SIX lower vertical legs grouped3+3. Keep gap between neighboring fork prongs and between all lower legs. Match relative proportions and bar placement of reference, no missing center stems, no extra roof or crossbars. IMPORTANT: truly uniform stroke width. Horizontal bars are constant-thickness straight lines with semicircular endcaps, NEVER pointed/elliptical brush dashes. No calligraphic taper.
